seed_items.canon_label_hint: Projection Trust State Model
exact_items: trust state: current, refreshing, stale, degraded, unavailable
current: projection is caught up enough for normal use
refreshing: old committed projection still visible while refresh/rebuild runs
stale: projection is usable for context but may not reflect current runtime truth
degraded: projector/scan partially failed or a dependency signal is missing
unavailable: projection cannot currently answer the surface contract
notes: Required field: trust state badge on projection-backed surfaces
Required field: last updated time display
Required consumer behavior: mutating actions restricted on stale/degraded projections
